column1: # IGNORE rules that are false positives or not applicable to a static demo target.
# FAIL rules that must block deployment in production (change fail_action to true).
# The scan target now runs the same nginx config the workload ships with (rendered
# from k8s/base/configmap.yaml — see .github/workflows/dast.yaml), so header rules
# are enforced against real config rather than a stock upstream container.
# Removed as redundant once the headers were set at the nginx layer:
#   10020  Missing anti-clickjacking header  — X-Frame-Options + CSP frame-ancestors
#   10021  X-Content-Type-Options missing    — now set to nosniff
#   10038  Content Security Policy not set   — now set
#   10036  Server leaks version information  — server_tokens off
#   90004  Insufficient site isolation       — COEP/COOP/CORP now set

column3: Strict-Transport-Security header missing (nginx in PoC has no TLS — handled by Istio in cluster)
